text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with King Halo...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just look! The cute plushies
are looking at King as if singing her praises!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction King Halo pointed, I saw a claw crane machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let us welcome them
as an imperial guard to showcase King's glory.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I shall grant you the privilege
of winning a plushie for King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Things like that are part of a Trainer's job, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To prove yourself worthy as the trainer of a first-rate lady like me,
show me your skills at the claw machine!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This King will be watching over you!
You had better give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
